title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Kospi -8%, circuit breaker triggered — Asia equities rout on US CPI/Fed hike fears
Crypto liquidations ~$1B (Oct 15); prior run logged $483M at 07:18 UTC
BTC ETF: $150.5M outflows Oct 14, reversed prior day's $175.7M inflow
Oct FOMC hike odds 26–30% (peaked ~48% post-CPI); decision Oct 28
BTC ~$80.9K (24h range $80.4K–$84.0K); prior -3.0% alert holds, not yet 4.5% re-alert
